issues.description: In the template repository the tests and the example program use different default fixed-point sizes: tests define FIX_LEN as 4 while the example program (and the example math headers) expect FIX_LEN as 8. This leads to inconsistent typedefs for fix_t between the test harness and the example program/assignment, causing confusion about the intended fixed-point width and likely resulting in mismatched behavior when students run tests versus the example program.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify FIX_LEN across the template repository so tests and the example program agree. For example, change tests/src/math_fix.h in the template repository to #define FIX_LEN 8 (to match example_program/src/math_fix.h), or document and set a single FIX_LEN value in a shared header used by both tests and the example program. Ensure the solution and template use the same FIX_LEN to avoid type/size mismatches for fix_t.
